description: This file defines the UpdateCatalogItemRequest class, a data transfer object (DTO) used for updating catalog items via the public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It includes properties for item details such as Id, CatalogBrandId, CatalogTypeId, Description, Name, Picture information, and Price, with data annotations for validation.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemRequest
classes.description: A DTO class for updating catalog items, inheriting from BaseRequest, with validation attributes on its properties.
